originalGraph: Compilation folds constants, erases branches, unrolls loops and discards IDs/layout/metadata. Multiple original block graphs can yield the same factory source.

methodology.scope: Only the explicit source manifest and immediate recovery test filenames; no recursive project scan.
methodology.compiler: AST cases of the outer block.opcode switches in irgen.descendInput/descendStackedBlock. Nested selector cases are excluded; menu/constants and procedures are included.
methodology.compatibility: Literal arrays from compat-blocks.js; entries overlapping direct cases do not imply the fallback is used.
methodology.decoder: Exact opcode string Literal values from the explicitly listed decoder files only. No schema keys/comments/embedded code strings, metadata helpers or enum names count toward this total.
methodology.schema: Imported RECOVERY_OPCODE_SCHEMA is argument metadata only. Schema-only entries never count as decoder implementation.
methodology.tests: Static test names/name templates and exact opcode literal mentions are inventory evidence only, including negative/shape/schema tests. Counts of known opcodes exclude opcode-shaped strings absent from the compiler/schema/decoder union. Generated families are not expanded or counted as executed tests.
methodology.verification: Source-mentioned, test-source-mentioned and behavior-tested are distinct. tested:null means no run result; no implementation or semantic coverage percentage is inferred.
